summary: Buenaventura filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report, announcing third-quarter 2026 production and sales volumes alongside updated full-year guidance. Q3 gold output totaled 37,375 ounces including associated companies, silver 3,255,320 ounces, plus lead, zinc and copper volumes. Realized prices averaged US$4,216/oz gold, US$57.82/oz silver, US$1,612/MT lead, US$3,987/MT zinc and US$15.19/MT copper. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is disclosed; the release is routine operational reporting from the Peruvian precious-metals miner, with watch items limited to guidance delivery versus stated ranges.
